description: List all active tmux sessions. Returns session name, window count, creation time, and attached status. WHEN TO CALL: Call this immediately whenever the user mentions tmux, asks to attach a session, wants to see terminal output, check logs, run a command in a pane, or interact with any running process. Do not answer from memory — always call this tool first to get live state. WORKFLOW: After getting sessions, ask the user which session, call list_windows, ask which window, call list_panes, ask which pane, then call capture_pane.
name: list_sessions
